title: Napa Cabbage and Tofu Soup with Shiitakes
instructions_list: Separate the cabbage and cube the tofu

Wash the cabbage, then cut the white ribs crosswise into 1-inch pieces. Tear the leaves into slightly larger pieces. Slice the mushroom caps thinly. Cut the drained tofu into ¾-inch cubes. Set the ginger and scallion whites by the stove and keep the greens for serving. The cabbage ribs and leaves sit in separate piles, ready to go in at different times.
Brown the mushrooms and simmer the ribs

Warm the oil in a soup pot over medium heat. Spread the mushrooms over the bottom and cook for about 3 minutes, turning once. Stir in the ginger and scallion whites for 30 seconds. Pour in the water, loosen any browned bits with a spoon and bring to a boil. Add the salt and cabbage ribs. Lower to a steady simmer for 4 minutes. The mushroom slices have browned edges and the cabbage ribs are becoming translucent at the edges.
Ease in the leaves and tofu

Lay the cabbage leaves on the broth and press them under gently. Slide the tofu cubes into the pot on a wide spoon. Keep the liquid barely bubbling for about 3–4 minutes. Ladle into two bowls and scatter the scallion greens on top. The leaves drape over the spoon, the thickest rib bends easily and the hot tofu cubes hold their shape.
description: Fresh shiitakes, ginger and scallion whites turn water into a light broth. Simmer the thick napa ribs first, then slip in the leaves and tofu so the cubes stay whole.
